verdict.rationale: Ingesting documents, JSON, or business data is a fair question for a memory layer, so the axis applies. However, every ingestion reference in the pack is about conversation turns: `client.add(messages, ...)`, "send conversation turns to add," and "pulls the individual facts out of the conversation." No documentation covers document, JSON, or business-data ingestion, and one community comment describes Mem0 as storing facts from conversations, so there is no evidence the product delivers beyond chat transcripts.

support.subject: As a developer, I can ingest documents, JSON, and business data into memory — not just chat transcripts
